frame: body axes from the model's origin (the empty CG): x forward, y right, z down; m, kg

basis.limits: estimate: no published figure (a heavy bomber's, below FAR 25.337's 2.5 transport minimum)
basis.strength: the design's ultimate load (1.5 x the flight control's n limits) at its design mass, flown symmetrically; tails and nose by the same rule (estimate)
basis.shares: hangar's strip model: dN/dalpha and dY/dbeta per section
